statements.quote: In a pre-registered seven-day lab experiment and a follow-up survey after 30 days of experiment completion, we examined the impacts of ChatGPT presence and absence on sustained creativity using a text dataset of 3302 creative ideas and 427 creative solutions from 61 college students.
statements.locator: p. 1, Abstract; preregistration and description of the study dataset

statements.quote: Sixty-one college students (Mage = 21.56 years, SD = 2.62) with 31 different majors from a university completed the lab experiment (per-registered at https://osf.io/hea8r).
statements.locator: p. 4, Section 2.1 Participants; the paper's only repository link

statements.quote: For problem-solving task, we remained all their answers. We randomized the order in a spreadsheet without any identifying information.
statements.locator: p. 6, Section 2.3 Creativity code and assessment; internal spreadsheet preparation, not a public-release statement

statements.quote: We provided raters with the spreadsheet and instructed them to evaluate each idea in it.
statements.locator: p. 6, Section 2.3 Creativity code and assessment; provision to raters, not public access

statements.quote: We utilized the R packages broom and dplyr for conducting t-tests to compare differences between the treatment and control groups. For data visualization, the ggplot2 package was employed.
statements.locator: p. 7, Section 3.1, final paragraph; named analysis and plotting software, with no code link

statements.quote: The results of creative scores are presented in Table 1 and Table 2. The visualization of these results can be found in Figures 2a and 2b (Only parts related to novelty and usefulness in Figure 2a and 2b are shown; see appendix for the rest..).
statements.locator: p. 7, Section 3.1, final paragraph; appendix on pp. 28-30 contains the remaining Figure 2a/2b panels

deposits.notes: Public preregistration titled 'The impact of over-reliance on generative AI on innovative thinking', registered 2023-10-30. Materials-only here means the structured preregistration text, not uploaded task materials. It describes the planned control and ChatGPT conditions but provides no participant-specific assignments, participant records, scores, texts, or analysis code. API flags has_data, has_analytic_code, has_materials, has_papers, and has_supplements are all false. https://api.osf.io/v2/registrations/hea8r/ returned 200 and public=true, embargoed=false, withdrawn=false. The initially required https://api.osf.io/v2/nodes/hea8r/ and /nodes/hea8r/children/ returned 404 because this identifier is a registration; /nodes/hea8r/files/osfstorage/ returned 200 with zero files. Correct registration endpoints /registrations/hea8r/files/ (200) listed only osfstorage; /registrations/hea8r/files/osfstorage/ (200), /registrations/hea8r/children/ (200), and /registrations/hea8r/linked_nodes/ (200) each returned zero items. /registrations/hea8r/resources/ initially timed out, then returned 200 with zero resources. No pagination remained. The license relationship https://api.osf.io/v2/licenses/563c1cf88c5e4a3877f9e96a/ returned 200 and identifies CC BY 4.0. The registered_from relationship identifies the authentication-protected source project zv8a4. The preregistration lists creativity among several planned measures but does not designate a primary creativity outcome; it cannot establish the analyzed counts or reconcile the paper's conflicting results.

Original source project linked by the paper's preregistration through registered_from, not a separately confirmed data release. The project API returned HTTP 401 with 'Authentication credentials were not provided.' The human-facing URL https://osf.io/zv8a4/ returned HTTP 200 containing only the generic OSF application shell, which does not establish public project access. Stopped after the authentication requirement; did not log in, request access, or attempt to enumerate/download protected files. Whether this project contains participant data, code, or any files is unknown. Authentication may still require contributor permission. found_by='paper' records the chain paper -> hea8r preregistration -> registered_from project.

notes: Read the entire 460-line markdown conversion of the 30-page saved PDF, including the appendix on pp. 28-30. Selected PDF pages were extracted with PyMuPDF to verify the quoted passages and page locators. The saved source is Liu et al.'s 2024 preprint 'When ChatGPT is gone: Creativity reverts and homogeneity persists', not the later journal article 'Creative scar without generative AI: Individual creativity fails to sustain while homogeneity keeps climbing' (10.1016/j.techsoc.2025.103087). Quotes preserve wording and punctuation with PDF line breaks normalized to spaces. The only URL in the markdown is the OSF preregistration; the PDF has no additional URI link annotations. forms/c012.json data_and_code has empty data_url and code_url. No explicit public-data, public-code, on-request-data, or separate downloadable-materials statement was found in the saved paper. The appendix contains additional aggregate figures, not participant records. The statements list also preserves the descriptions of the raters' spreadsheets and the named analysis software; neither is a promise of public availability. No participant-level data file was found or read. Status 'restricted' refers specifically to the linked original OSF project requiring authentication; it does not assert that usable participant data are deposited there. The accessible OSF record is preregistration documentation only. Searches used both title stems and both first authors because author order differs between versions. All requested search services ultimately returned results successfully; no relevant additional data deposit was identified. The four candidate ScienceDB dataset descriptions were checked through the DataCite DOI endpoints (all HTTP 200) and excluded as unrelated. https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.06816 returned HTTP 200, lists only v1 submitted 2024-01-11, and supplied no paper-specific data deposit; it is not counted as a data deposit. The publisher's HTTP 403 prevents checking the journal version's supplementary files and availability statement, limiting confidence. The public materials do not support computing the missing participant-level arm SDs/SEs, per-day analyzed counts (especially Day 30 by arm), resolution of conflicting Day 30 AUT means/tests or Task 2 usefulness results, or participant-resampled diversity uncertainty from the original texts. Preregistration inspection addresses the existence and contents of the registered plan but supplies none of those missing statistics. No other file was written, and no account, access request, or authentication was used.
